arguments.value: This is a reseller agreement in which PivX gives Detto the right to market and resell Qwik-Fix Pro, with stricter rights in North America and more limited rights elsewhere. Detto may only distribute the software to end customers who accept PivX’s license terms, cannot reverse engineer or copy the software, and must follow PivX’s branding, security, and compliance rules. Detto is responsible for its own marketing, customer support, sales reporting, and legal compliance, and must not make promises beyond PivX’s warranties. Detto also has to pay PivX per-copy fees on time, cover applicable taxes, and allow audits; if it defaults, PivX can suspend sales rights and collect payments directly. PivX keeps ownership of the software, trademarks, and intellectual property, and gives only limited warranty protection, plus an indemnity if the product infringes a third party’s rights. Detto must indemnify PivX for Detto’s breaches or misconduct. The agreement lasts six months, can be terminated on notice or for uncured material breach, and requires Detto to stop using and return the software and materials at the end. The agreement also includes confidentiality, liability limits, California law and California courts, and other standard legal terms.
